relevance_note: Case series of eight LAD-1 patients with individual ITGB2 genotypes and clinical courses: "We describe eight patients (identified as P1, P2, P3, P4, P5, P6, P7, P8) with diagnosis of LAD-1".
method_note: Read the whole paper (accepted-manuscript PDF conversion). Values were chosen by reading; a Python script in the scratch directory assembled the JSON, cut Table 1 and Table 2 row spans from the patient label through the cited cell, and checked every span verbatim. Rows are P1-P8 as labelled by the paper. Conversion artefacts: Table 1 is split across a page break; the unlabelled row after the footnote ('| | | | | K755del] | | Aphthous stomatitis, ...') is the continuation of P6 (it completes P6's p.[D750- K755del] cell), so its clinical cell was attributed to P6 and quoted together with the P6 row. Words spill between rows: P1's cell ends 'Cold skin' and P2's begins 'MANUSCRIPT abscess'; P5's ends 'Ost eomyeliti' and P6's begins 's'. P5 osteomyelitis was recorded from its row; P1's 'Cold skin [abscess]' fragment was not recorded (P1's skin infection comes from the text). The Markdown writes '>' as '>' in the text; values use '>' and spans keep '>'. Age at diagnosis is the Table 1 column 'Age at di agnosi s (years)' (ISO given as decimal years); the follow-up time column is a duration, not an age, so age at last evaluation is not reported. Variant strings: HGVS c. notation was preferred where printed (text for P2, P4, P5, P8; Table 1 for P1, P3, P6, P7). Transcript ENST00000302347.9 is the paper's stated reference sequence for all mutations; P2's sentence gives NM_000211.3. Zygosity 'homozygous' for P1 and P3 comes from Table 1 listing the same deletion on both alleles ('Mutations in the CD18 alleles of patients'); the text does not state zygosity for them. Exclusions inferred from named-group statements: 'Five of the eight patients ... presented delayed separation of umbilical cord (P1, P2, P4, P6, P7)' -> excluded for P3, P5, P8; 'omphalitis ... only in P4, but not in the other patients'; 'Five of the eight patients (P1, P2, P5, P6, P7) had signs of periodontal diseases' -> excluded for P3, P4, P8; autoantibodies 'detected in six out of the eight' (named) -> excluded for P4, P8. 'Six of the eight patients (P1, P2, P5, P6, P7, P8) showed impaired wound healing and skin/soft tissue infections' was NOT used to exclude either feature for P3/P4, because the statement joins two features. 'Seven out of eight patients showed at least one episode of sepsis' names no one, so P8 sepsis is not reported. Table 1 '-' in the autoantibody column (P4, P8) is not defined by a legend and was not used. Enteritis (P3, P5) and enterocolitis (P7) were mapped to checklist 'gastrointestinal infections' because the paper lists them as infectious manifestations; enterocolitis also to colitis. Autoantibodies alone (P6, P7 anti-TG) were not counted as 'autoimmune complications'. Cyclosporine A ('In these patients, cyclosporine A was used') was not attributed because 'these patients' could be P1-P3 or P1-P4. The 'matched related sibling' donor of P1 gets no row (not tested or affected). Bacterial isolates in Table 1 were not recorded as features. Ref 15 (Marsili 2014, a girl with LAD-1 treated with anti-TNF) and ref 12 are cited next to P5 and P7 but the paper does not say they describe the same patients, so only refs 5 (P1-P3) and 14 (P6) are given as prior reports. Mutation novelty ('novel' for P1, P3, P6, P8; 'previously reported' for P2, P4, P5, P7, P8) was not recorded as pathogenicity. CONTRADICTIONS: (1) P2: text 'homozygous nonsense mutation ... c.79A > T' but Table 1 'c.[A79T];del p.L27*;?' (second allele a deletion; text notes ring 21 chromosome) -> P2 zygosity not reported; the 'del' allele kept as its own variant row. (2) P5: text 'c.1906T>C' vs Table 1 'c.[T1834C];[ T1834C]' (both p.C612R/p.Cys612Arg); text string recorded. (3) P7: text '(A151T) with premature termination at codon L27' vs Table 1 'c.[A79T];[A79T] p.[L27*];[L27*]'; table string recorded. (4) P6: text 'IVS 15-2 A>G' vs Table 1 'c.[2081-2A>G]' (alternative notations). (5) P4 CD18: text 'undetectable' vs Table 1 '<2%'. (6) 'CD18 was undetectable on leukocytes of the four patients (P1, P2, P3, P4, P8)' lists five; 'the remaining four identified in patients P2, P4, P5, P7, P8' lists five, and P8 is in both the novel and the previously reported list. (7) 'Seven of the eight patients (87.5%: P2-P7) are Caucasian' covers six labels; P8 ethnicity left not reported. (8) P5 is 'partial' in Table 1 and 'moderate LAD-1' in the text. (9) P7 renal ultrasound 'At 30 years of age' while Table 1 gives diagnosis at 4.01 years and follow-up 21.76 years. (10) P3 is named among HSCT patients with 'Autoimmune diseases' (P1, P2, P3), but the Discussion says autoantibodies in three transplanted patients were 'associated with autoimmune diseases in two of them'; only a low-titre ANA is described for P3. P3's checklist autoimmune item follows the named statement (observed).
